thread:
neel: FYI, post short-kernel rollout we
re seeing p95 regressions for tiny streaming responses (<=80 tokens). host parsing + small gRPC writes are the main suspects.
tara: saw the same alert. any flamegraph excerpts?
neel: pasted sample:
```
flame: http_ingress -> parse_stream_frames -> utf8_full_norm -> small_write_flush -> grpc_stream_write -> epoll_wait
hotspots: small_write_flush (41%), utf8_full_norm (19%), grpc_stream_write (12%)
```
yusuf: that small_write_flush indicates we're flushing per chunk. the kernel gains mean host syscalls now dominate micro-latency.
sam: two quick mitigations: 1) host mini-aggregator to coalesce adjacent small frames into one write (knobs: max_bytes, max_frames, timeout_ms); 2) utf8 quick-sketch check to skip heavy normalization on already-NFC inputs. low-risk to start.
neel: ran a quick microbench: aggregator(max_frames=3,max_bytes=3072,timeout_ms=6) + utf8 sketch reduced p95 from 230ms -> 165ms for <=64-token streams; write syscalls per request -3.7x; proxy CPU +5%.
tara: what's the kv interaction? holding frames might increase serialization at kv-leaders for multi-chunk miss flows.
yusuf: confirmed in traces: large multi-chunk requests (10+ frames) can see ~5% kv latency bump during naive aggregation canary. we should add bypass rules.
sam: proposal: defaults on aggregator; bypass if frame_count>9 OR body_size>96KB. For kv_miss paths, tighter bypass: frame_count>5. also expose per-tenant opt-out for heavy streamers.
neel: added cheap utf8 sketch heuristic (scan for non-ascii combining marks + quick NFC fingerprint). false-positive ~0.5% in bench; avoids full normalize in most cases.
tara: telemetry needed before broad roll: histograms host.preproc.utf8_sketch_ms, counters host.streamer.grpc_write_calls, histo host.streamer.agg_held_bytes, and tagged counter host.streamer.agg_bypass_reason.
sam: added metrics in branch:
```
metrics.hist("host.preproc.utf8_sketch_ms", sketch_ms)
metrics.count("host.streamer.grpc_write_calls", write_calls)
metrics.histo("host.streamer.agg_held_bytes", held_bytes)
metrics.tagged_count("host.streamer.agg_bypass_reason", reason)
```
ops-bot: deploy streamer-miniagg-canary -> intake-7 (5%)
ops-bot: rollout started: 5% -> 100% in 12m if healthy
tara: initial 15m canary: p95 -21% vs baseline on short streams; grpc_write_calls -3.8x; utf8_sketch_ms median 0.08ms. one tenant with 25-frame bursts showed kv latency +6%.
yusuf: tighten kv_miss bypass for canary to frame_count>4 and add tenant opt-out.
neel: pushed update and expanded canary to 20%. heavy-tenant kv latency back to baseline; overall p95 -18%.
sam: PR checklist: microbench scripts, flame captures, config knobs host.streamer.agg_bytes, host.streamer.agg_frames, host.streamer.agg_timeout_ms, host.preproc.utf8_sketch=true, host.streamer.kv_bypass_frame_threshold, and per-tenant opt-out. add kernel-rollout note: always validate host write consolidation when enabling short-seq kernels.
tara: scheduling 20m follow-up tomorrow to pick defaults and prod rollout cadence. labels: perf, host-parse, grpc, kvcache.
